ops.title: Replace CCX fixed GitHub quota floor with header-based pacing
ops.description: Owner root. Approved by user Nov15. Inspect current gateway quota/header behavior, implement smaller background reserve with resource-specific admission and real throttling backoff, hosted regression coverage, merge release install and verify locally. Preserve sessions and all held campaign work.

ops.text: No fixed 1000 cutoff or stale alternate-window refusal of a healthy latest header; core GraphQL search remain independent.
Real primary and secondary exhaustion honors response headers and retry/reset; routine background polling retains a small reserve.
Merged released installed locally and affected-case verification recorded.
